source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Quickly note down what failed from these records.
3. When you go to take photos, start by noting down the failed appliance and plug serial numbers.
4. Photograph the failed side, and any distinguishing features like labels or faults.
5. Move on to other appliances, but note down the same relevant data.
6. Take plenty of close-up photos focused on the issue and faults.
7. Do the same process with the next appliance and so on.
8. Repeat this process for all failed appliances.
9. Be thorough and take enough photos for each issue.
10. Ensure all photos are clear and high-resolution.
11. Include visible detail even from a distance of 30 cm.
12. Organize photos into folders for each type of issue.
13. Keep a consistent photo naming convention for organization.
14. Include manufacturer and model numbers when known.
